reply.english: I'd like to work as a doctor.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: مَرْحَبًا يَا هُدَى. مَا عَمَلُكِ؟
dialogue.transliteration: marhaban yaa Hudaa. maa 3amaluki?
dialogue.english: Hello, Huda. What do you do?

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: أَعْمَلُ مُهَنْدِسَةً. وَمَا عَمَلُكَ أَنْتَ؟
dialogue.transliteration: a3malu muhandisa. wa maa 3amaluka anta?
dialogue.english: I work as an engineer. And what do you do?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: مَا زِلْتُ طَالِبًا. أَدْرُسُ الطِّبّ.
dialogue.transliteration: maa zultu taaliban. adrusu at-tibb.
dialogue.english: I'm still a student. I study medicine.

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: رَائِع! وَأَيْنَ تَدْرُس؟
dialogue.transliteration: raa2i3! wa ayna tadrus?
dialogue.english: Wonderful! And where do you study?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: أَدْرُسُ فِي جَامِعَةِ دِمَشْق. وَأَيْنَ تَعْمَلِينَ أَنْتِ؟
dialogue.transliteration: adrusu fee jaami3ati Dimashq. wa ayna ta3maleena anti?
dialogue.english: I study at Damascus University. And where do you work?

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: أَعْمَلُ مِنَ الْبَيْت. عَمَلِي جَيِّد.
dialogue.transliteration: a3malu mina al-bayt. 3amalee jayyid.
dialogue.english: I work from home. My job is good.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: كَمْ سَنَةً تَعْمَلِينَ فِي هَذَا الْمَجَال؟
dialogue.transliteration: kam sanatan ta3maleena fee haadhaa al-majaal?
dialogue.english: How many years have you worked in this field?

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: مُنْذُ خَمْسِ سَنَوَات. وَمَاذَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ بَعْدَ التَّخَرُّج؟
dialogue.transliteration: mundhu khamsi sanawaat. wa maadhaa tureedu an ta3mala ba3da at-takharruj?
dialogue.english: For five years. And what would you like to work as after graduating?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَعْمَلَ طَبِيبًا. أَبْحَثُ الْآنَ عَنْ عَمَلٍ جَدِيد.
dialogue.transliteration: ureedu an a3mala tabeeban. ab7athu al-aana 3an 3amalin jadeed.
dialogue.english: I'd like to work as a doctor. I'm looking for a new job now.

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: بِالتَّوْفِيق! وَالِدِي مُتَقَاعِد، وَهُوَ سَعِيدٌ جِدًّا.
dialogue.transliteration: bit-tawfeeq! waalidee mutaqaa3id, wa huwa sa3eedun jiddan.
dialogue.english: Good luck! My father is retired, and he is very happy.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: شُكْرًا يَا هُدَى. مَعَ السَّلَامَة.
dialogue.transliteration: shukran yaa Hudaa. ma3a as-salaama.
dialogue.english: Thank you, Huda. Goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: مَعَ السَّلَامَة.
dialogue.transliteration: ma3a as-salaama.
dialogue.english: Goodbye.

pair.english: What do you do? (to a man)
How many years have you been working here?

lessons.culture: In Fusha, the usual way to ask about someone's work is مَا عَمَلُكَ؟ or مَا مِهْنَتُكَ؟, and the answer is often given as أَعْمَلُ followed by the job. People ask about work early in a first meeting, and a polite question about it is never rude.

exercises.prompt: A man asks you: 'مَا عَمَلُكَ؟'. Say that you are still a student.
exercises.tip: مَا زِلْتُ means 'I am still'; the word after it takes the ending ـًا.

exercises.prompt: Someone asks you: 'أَيْنَ تَعْمَل؟'. Say that you work from home.
exercises.tip: أَعْمَلُ is 'I work'; مِنَ الْبَيْت is 'from home'.

exercises.prompt: A woman asks you: 'مَاذَا تَدْرُس؟'. Say that you study medicine.
exercises.tip: أَدْرُسُ means 'I study'; the subject follows directly.

exercises.prompt: Complete the question: 'كَمْ _____ تَعْمَلُ هُنَا؟' (How many years have you been working here?)
exercises.tip: After كَمْ the counted word takes the ending ـًا: كَمْ سَنَةً.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'أَبْحَثُ _____ عَمَلٍ جَدِيد.' (I'm looking for a new job.)
exercises.tip: بَحَثَ is followed by عَنْ: 'search for'.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'I'm retired.'
exercises.tip: مُتَقَاعِد comes from التَّقَاعُد, 'retirement'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'My job is good.'
exercises.tip: No word for 'is' is needed: عَمَلِي جَيِّد.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'I'm not finding a job.'
exercises.tip: لَا before a present verb makes it negative: لَا أَجِدُ.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence asks a woman what her job is?
exercises.tip: The ending كِ with a long ee sound is for a woman; كَ is for a man.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'I work from home'?
exercises.tip: مِنَ الْبَيْت is 'from the house', so 'from home'.

exercises.prompt: Put these words in order: 'الْبَيْت / مِنَ / أَعْمَلُ'.
exercises.tip: The verb comes first, then the place.

reply.english: Yes, I'll come in a moment.

phrases.arabic: يَجِبُ أَنْ نُنْهِيَ هَذِهِ الْمُهِمَّةَ قَبْلَ الظُّهْر
phrases.transliteration: yajibu an nunhiya haadhihi al-muhimmata qabla adh-dhuhr

dialogue.speaker: Khalid
dialogue.arabic: صَبَاحَ الْخَيْر يَا مَهَا. هَلْ سَتَحْضُرِينَ الِاجْتِمَاع؟
dialogue.transliteration: sabaa7a al-khayr yaa Mahaa. hal sata7dureena al-ijtimaa3?
dialogue.english: Good morning, Maha. Are you coming to the meeting?

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، عِنْدِي اجْتِمَاعٌ فِي السَّاعَةِ الْعَاشِرَة.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, 3indee ijtimaa3un fee as-saa3ati al-3aashira.
dialogue.english: Yes, I have a meeting at ten o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: Khalid
dialogue.arabic: الْمُدِيرُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَحَدَّثَ مَعَكِ بَعْدَهُ.
dialogue.transliteration: al-mudeeru yureedu an yata7addatha ma3aki ba3dahu.
dialogue.english: The manager wants to talk to you after it.

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.arabic: حَسَنًا. لَمْ أُنْهِ التَّقْرِيرَ بَعْد.
dialogue.transliteration: 7asanan. lam unhi at-taqreera ba3d.
dialogue.english: Alright. I haven't finished the report yet.

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.arabic: أَعْرِفُ. مُدِيرُنَا مُتَطَلِّبٌ جِدًّا.
dialogue.transliteration: a3rifu. mudeeruna mutatallibun jiddan.
dialogue.english: I know. Our manager is very demanding.

dialogue.speaker: Khalid
dialogue.arabic: لَكِنَّ زَمِيلَنَا فِي الْمَكْتَبِ لَطِيفٌ جِدًّا.
dialogue.transliteration: lakinna zameelanaa fee al-maktabi lateefun jiddan.
dialogue.english: But our colleague at the office is very nice.

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.arabic: صَحِيح. هَلْ وَصَلَتْكَ رِسَالَتِي؟
dialogue.transliteration: sa7eeh. hal wasalatka risaalatee?
dialogue.english: True. Did my message reach you?

dialogue.speaker: Khalid
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، اِسْتَلَمْتُ رِسَالَتَكِ صَبَاحًا.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, istalamtu risaalataki sabaa7an.
dialogue.english: Yes, I received your message this morning.

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.arabic: لَكِنَّ الطَّابِعَةَ تَتَعَطَّلُ دَائِمًا.
dialogue.transliteration: lakinna at-taabi3ata tata3attalu daa2iman.
dialogue.english: But the printer keeps breaking down.

dialogue.speaker: Khalid
dialogue.arabic: سَنَطْلُبُ طَابِعَةً جَدِيدَة. هَلْ هُنَاكَ عَمَلٌ إِضَافِيٌّ الْيَوْم؟
dialogue.transliteration: sanatlubu taabi3atan jadeeda. hal hunaaka 3amalun idaafiyyun al-yawm?
dialogue.english: We'll ask for a new printer. Is there overtime today?

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.arabic: لَا أَظُنّ. أَخَذْتُ إِجَازَةً يَوْمَيْنِ وَسَأَعْمَلُ بِجِدّ.
dialogue.transliteration: laa azunn. akhadhtu ijaazatan yawmayni wa sa-a3malu bijidd.
dialogue.english: I don't think so. I took two days off and I'll work hard.

pair.english: Are you coming to the meeting?

response.english: Yes, I'll come in a moment.

pair.english: I haven't finished the report yet.
The manager wants to talk to you.

lessons.culture: Office talk in Fusha is polite and direct, and the word الْمُدِيرُ is used for any boss or manager. Emails and reports are written in Fusha, while people often chat in their own dialect at the desk.

exercises.prompt: A colleague asks: 'هَلْ سَتَحْضُرُ الِاجْتِمَاع؟'. Say yes, you'll come in a moment.
exercises.tip: سَ before a verb makes it future: سَآتِي, 'I will come'.

exercises.prompt: Your colleague says: 'الْمُدِيرُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَحَدَّثَ مَعَكَ'. Reply that you are coming.
exercises.tip: قَادِم is 'coming' and needs no verb for 'am'.

exercises.prompt: Someone asks: 'هَلْ هُنَاكَ عَمَلٌ إِضَافِيٌّ الْيَوْم؟'. Say no, not today.
exercises.tip: لَيْسَ negates a whole phrase: 'it is not today'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'لَمْ أُنْهِ التَّقْرِيرَ _____.' (I haven't finished the report yet.)
exercises.tip: لَمْ ... بَعْدُ means 'not yet'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: '_____ أَنْ نُنْهِيَ هَذِهِ الْمُهِمَّةَ قَبْلَ الظُّهْر.' (We must finish this task before noon.)
exercises.tip: يَجِبُ أَنْ means 'it is necessary that'.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'My boss is very demanding.'
exercises.tip: جِدًّا means 'very' and comes after the describing word.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'I took two days off.'
exercises.tip: يَوْمَيْن is the dual of يَوْم: exactly two days.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'The printer keeps breaking down.'
exercises.tip: دَائِمًا means 'always', so the breakdown repeats.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'I have a meeting at ten o'clock'?
exercises.tip: السَّاعَةُ الْعَاشِرَة is 'the tenth hour', so ten o'clock.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence says that the salary comes at the end of the month?
exercises.tip: نِهَايَة is 'end'; الشَّهْر is 'the month'.

exercises.prompt: Put these words in order: 'لَطِيفٌ / زَمِيلِي / جِدًّا / فِي الْمَكْتَبِ'.
exercises.tip: The person first, then where, then the description.

phrases.arabic: يَجِبُ أَنْ أَدْرُسَ كَثِيرًا هَذَا الْفَصْل
phrases.transliteration: yajibu an adrusa katheeran haadhaa al-fasl
zaharat nateejatu al-imti7aani wa hiya jayyida

phrases.arabic: يَجِبُ أَنْ أُسَلِّمَ الْوَاجِبَ قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَة
phrases.transliteration: yajibu an usallima al-waajiba qabla yawmi al-jumu3a

phrases.arabic: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَجِّلَ مَوَادَّ أَكْثَرَ فِي الْفَصْلِ الْقَادِم
phrases.transliteration: ureedu an usajjila mawaadda akthara fee al-fasli al-qaadim

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: صَبَاحَ الْخَيْر يَا سَارَة. مَا تَخَصُّصُكِ؟
dialogue.transliteration: sabaa7a al-khayr yaa Saara. maa takhassusuki?
dialogue.english: Good morning, Sara. What's your major?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: تَخَصُّصِي الْهَنْدَسَة. وَأَنْتَ، فِي أَيِّ سَنَةٍ أَنْتَ؟
dialogue.transliteration: takhassusee al-handasa. wa anta, fee ayyi sanatin anta?
dialogue.english: My major is engineering. And you, what year are you in?

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: أَنَا فِي السَّنَةِ الثَّالِثَة. عِنْدِي اِمْتِحَانٌ غَدًا.
dialogue.transliteration: anaa fee as-sanati ath-thaalitha. 3indee imti7aanun ghadan.
dialogue.english: I'm in the third year. I have an exam tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: حَقًّا؟ عِنْدِي مُحَاضَرَةٌ فِي السَّاعَةِ التَّاسِعَة، لَكِنَّ الْأُسْتَاذَ غَائِبٌ الْيَوْم.
dialogue.transliteration: 7aqqan? 3indee muhaadaratun fee as-saa3ati at-taasi3a, lakinna al-ustaadha ghaa2ibun al-yawm.
dialogue.english: Really? I have a lecture at nine, but the professor is absent today.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: لَمْ أَفْهَمِ الْمُحَاضَرَةَ السَّابِقَةَ جَيِّدًا.
dialogue.transliteration: lam afhami al-muhaadarata as-saabiqata jayyidan.
dialogue.english: I didn't understand the last lecture well.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: سَأَشْرَحُهَا لَكِ فِي الْمَكْتَبَة.
dialogue.transliteration: sa-ash7uhaa laki fee al-maktaba.
dialogue.english: I'll explain it to you in the library.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: مَكْتَبَةُ الْجَامِعَةِ مَفْتُوحَةٌ حَتَّى اللَّيْل، أَلَيْسَ كَذَلِك؟
dialogue.transliteration: maktabatu al-jaami3ati maftoo7atun 7attaa al-layl, alaysa kadhaalik?
dialogue.english: The university library is open until night, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: بَلَى. وَيَجِبُ أَنْ أُسَلِّمَ الْوَاجِبَ قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَة.
dialogue.transliteration: balaa. wa yajibu an usallima al-waajiba qabla yawmi al-jumu3a.
dialogue.english: Yes. And I have to submit the assignment before Friday.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَجِّلَ مَوَادَّ أَكْثَرَ فِي الْفَصْلِ الْقَادِم.
dialogue.transliteration: wa anaa ureedu an usajjila mawaadda akthara fee al-fasli al-qaadim.
dialogue.english: And I want to register more courses next semester.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: أَصْدِقَاؤُنَا فِي الْجَامِعَةِ لُطَفَاءُ، وَسَيُسَاعِدُونَكِ.
dialogue.transliteration: asdiqaa2unaa fee al-jaami3ati lutafaa2u, wa sa-yusaa3idoonaki.
dialogue.english: Our friends at university are nice, and they will help you.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: شُكْرًا يَا يُوسُف. إِلَى اللِّقَاء.
dialogue.transliteration: shukran yaa Yoosuf. ilaa al-liqaa2.
dialogue.english: Thank you, Yusuf. See you.

response.english: No, I didn't understand it well.

lessons.culture: University teaching in the Arab world is often in Fusha, especially in the sciences and the humanities, and lecturers are addressed as أُسْتَاذ or دُكْتُور. Students wish each other بِالتَّوْفِيق before an exam.

exercises.prompt: A friend says: 'عِنْدِي اِمْتِحَانٌ غَدًا'. Wish them luck.
exercises.tip: بِالتَّوْفِيق means 'with success'.

exercises.prompt: Someone asks: 'مَا تَخَصُّصُكَ؟'. Say that your major is engineering.
exercises.tip: تَخَصُّصِي is 'my major'; the subject follows it.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks: 'هَلْ فَهِمْتَ الْمُحَاضَرَة؟'. Say you didn't understand it well.
exercises.tip: The ending ـهَا means 'it' and refers to the lecture.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'عِنْدِي _____ فِي السَّاعَةِ التَّاسِعَة.' (I have a lecture at nine.)
exercises.tip: مُحَاضَرَة is a lecture; a class is حِصَّة at school.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'الْأُسْتَاذُ _____ الْيَوْم.' (The professor is absent today.)
exercises.tip: غَائِب is 'absent'; its opposite is حَاضِر.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'I have an exam tomorrow.'
exercises.tip: غَدًا is 'tomorrow'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'What year are you in?'
exercises.tip: أَيّ means 'which'; for a woman end with أَنْتِ.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'The university library is open until night.'
exercises.tip: حَتَّى means 'until'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'I have to submit the assignment before Friday'?
options: يَجِبُ أَنْ أُسَلِّمَ الْوَاجِبَ قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَة
يَجِبُ أَنْ أَدْرُسَ كَثِيرًا هَذَا الْفَصْل
exercises.answer: يَجِبُ أَنْ أُسَلِّمَ الْوَاجِبَ قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَة
accepted: يَجِبُ أَنْ أُسَلِّمَ الْوَاجِبَ قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَة
يجب ان اسلم الواجب قبل يوم الجمعة
yajibu an usallima al-waajiba qabla yawmi al-jumu3a
يَجِبُ أَنْ أُسَلِّمَ الْوَاجِبَ قَبْلَ الْجُمُعَة
exercises.tip: الْوَاجِب is homework; قَبْلَ means 'before'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'The exam result came out good'?
accepted: zaharat nateejatu al-imti7aani wa hiya jayyida
exercises.tip: ظَهَرَتْ means 'appeared', so the result was published.

exercises.prompt: Put these words in order: 'أُسَجِّلَ / أَنْ / مَوَادَّ أَكْثَرَ / أُرِيدُ / فِي الْفَصْلِ الْقَادِم'.
exercises.answer: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَجِّلَ مَوَادَّ أَكْثَرَ فِي الْفَصْلِ الْقَادِم
accepted: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَجِّلَ مَوَادَّ أَكْثَرَ فِي الْفَصْلِ الْقَادِم
اريد ان اسجل مواد اكثر في الفصل القادم
ureedu an usajjila mawaadda akthara fee al-fasli al-qaadim
أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَجِّلَ مَوَادَّ أَكْثَرَ الْفَصْلَ الْقَادِم

too_formal.item: بَدِّي سَجِّل مَوَاد أَكْثَر بِالْفَصْل الْجَايّ

exercises.tip: أُرِيدُ أَنْ is followed by a verb in the present form.

phrases.arabic: مَاذَا تَنْوِي أَنْ تَفْعَلَ بَعْدَ التَّخَرُّج؟
phrases.transliteration: maadhaa tanwee an taf3ala ba3da at-takharruj?

reply.english: I want to continue my studies.

phrases.arabic: أُفَكِّرُ فِي السَّفَرِ لِلْعَمَلِ فِي الْخَارِج
phrases.transliteration: ufakkiru fee as-safari lil-3amali fee al-khaarij

reply.english: I hope to be a manager.

phrases.arabic: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْتَقِرَّ وَأَتَزَوَّجَ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَعْمَلَ قَلِيلًا
phrases.transliteration: ureedu an astaqirra wa atazawwaja ba3da an a3mala qaleelan

phrases.arabic: طُمُوحِي أَنْ أُصْبِحَ مُدِيرًا يَوْمًا مَا
phrases.transliteration: tumoo7ee an usbi7a mudeeran yawman maa

phrases.arabic: الْأَهَمُّ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُرْتَاحًا فِي عَمَلِي

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: مَاذَا تَنْوِينَ أَنْ تَفْعَلِي بَعْدَ التَّخَرُّج؟
dialogue.transliteration: maadhaa tanweena an taf3alee ba3da at-takharruj?
dialogue.english: What do you plan to do after you graduate?

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: رَائِع. وَهَلْ سَتُحَاوِلِينَ الِالْتِحَاقَ بِبَرْنَامَجِ الدُّكْتُورَاه؟
dialogue.transliteration: raa2i3. wa hal sa-tuhaawileena al-iltihaaqa bi-barnaamaji ad-duktooraah?
dialogue.english: Wonderful. And will you try to enter a PhD program?

dialogue.speaker: Noura
dialogue.arabic: سَأُحَاوِلُ ذَلِكَ. وَأَنْتَ، مَاذَا سَتَفْعَل؟
dialogue.transliteration: sa-uhaawilu dhaalik. wa anta, maadhaa sa-taf3al?
dialogue.english: I'll try that. And you, what will you do?

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: لَمْ أُقَرِّرْ بَعْدُ. أُفَكِّرُ فِي السَّفَرِ لِلْعَمَلِ فِي الْخَارِج.
dialogue.transliteration: lam uqarrir ba3du. ufakkiru fee as-safari lil-3amali fee al-khaarij.
dialogue.english: I haven't decided yet. I'm thinking of traveling to work abroad.

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: سَأَتَقَدَّمُ لِوَظِيفَةٍ فِي شَرِكَةٍ كَبِيرَة، وَبَعْدَهَا أَبْدَأُ مَشْرُوعِي الْخَاصّ.
dialogue.transliteration: sa-ataqaddamu liwazeefatin fee sharikatin kabeera, wa ba3dahaa abda2u mashroo3ee al-khaass.
dialogue.english: I'll apply for a job at a big company, and after that I'll start my own project.

dialogue.speaker: Noura
dialogue.arabic: الْأَهَمُّ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُرْتَاحَةً فِي عَمَلِي.
dialogue.transliteration: al-ahammu an akoona murtaa7atan fee 3amalee.
dialogue.english: The most important thing is to be comfortable in my job.

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْتَقِرَّ وَأَتَزَوَّجَ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَعْمَلَ قَلِيلًا.
dialogue.transliteration: wa anaa ureedu an astaqirra wa atazawwaja ba3da an a3mala qaleelan.
dialogue.english: And I want to settle down and get married after I work a bit.

dialogue.speaker: Noura
dialogue.arabic: بِالتَّوْفِيقِ لَنَا!
dialogue.transliteration: bit-tawfeeqi lanaa!
dialogue.english: Good luck to us!

pair.arabic: مَاذَا تَنْوِي أَنْ تَفْعَلَ بَعْدَ التَّخَرُّج؟
pair.transliteration: maadhaa tanwee an taf3ala ba3da at-takharruj?
pair.english: What do you plan to do after you graduate?

response.english: I want to continue my studies.

pair.english: In five years, where will you be?

response.english: I hope to be a manager.

pair.english: Have you decided what you'll do?

response.english: My dream is to open a restaurant.

lessons.culture: Talking about plans in Fusha often uses أُرِيدُ أَنْ, أَنْوِي أَنْ or سَ before a verb, and people add إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّه when speaking about the future. Plans about study, work and marriage are shared easily with friends and family.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks: 'مَاذَا تَنْوِي أَنْ تَفْعَلَ بَعْدَ التَّخَرُّج؟'. Say you want to continue your studies for a master's.
exercises.tip: After أُرِيدُ أَنْ the verb ends with the vowel a: أُكْمِلَ.

exercises.prompt: Someone asks: 'بَعْدَ خَمْسِ سَنَوَاتٍ، أَيْنَ سَتَكُون؟'. Say you hope to be a manager.
exercises.tip: أَتَمَنَّى means 'I hope' or 'I wish'.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks: 'هَلْ قَرَّرْتَ مَاذَا سَتَفْعَل؟'. Say not yet.
exercises.tip: لَمْ with the present form means 'did not'; بَعْد adds 'yet'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'حُلْمِي أَنْ _____ مَطْعَمًا.' (My dream is to open a restaurant.)
exercises.tip: فَتَحَ is 'to open'; after أَنْ it becomes أَفْتَحَ.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'بَعْدَ خَمْسِ _____، أَيْنَ سَتَكُون؟' (In five years, where will you be?)
exercises.tip: Three to ten takes the plural: خَمْسُ سَنَوَات.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'My ambition is to become a manager one day.'
exercises.answer: طُمُوحِي أَنْ أُصْبِحَ مُدِيرًا يَوْمًا مَا
accepted: طُمُوحِي أَنْ أُصْبِحَ مُدِيرًا يَوْمًا مَا
طموحي ان اصبح مديرا يوما ما
طُمُوحِي أَنْ أَصِيرَ مُدِيرًا يَوْمًا مَا
tumoo7ee an usbi7a mudeeran yawman maa

too_formal.item: طُمُوحِي صِير مُدِير يَوْم مِنَ الْأَيَّام

exercises.tip: أَصْبَحَ means 'to become' and takes the ending ـًا after it.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'I'm thinking of traveling to work abroad.'
exercises.answer: أُفَكِّرُ فِي السَّفَرِ لِلْعَمَلِ فِي الْخَارِج
accepted: أُفَكِّرُ فِي السَّفَرِ لِلْعَمَلِ فِي الْخَارِج
افكر في السفر للعمل في الخارج
أُفَكِّرُ فِي السَّفَرِ لِلْعَمَلِ خَارِجَ الْبَلَد
ufakkiru fee as-safari lil-3amali fee al-khaarij
exercises.tip: فَكَّرَ فِي means 'to think about'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'The most important thing is to be comfortable in my job.'
exercises.answer: الْأَهَمُّ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُرْتَاحًا فِي عَمَلِي
accepted: الْأَهَمُّ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُرْتَاحًا فِي عَمَلِي
الاهم ان اكون مرتاحا في عملي
الْأَهَمُّ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُرْتَاحًا فِي الْعَمَل
exercises.tip: الْأَهَمّ means 'the most important'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'I intend to start my own project'?
exercises.tip: نَوَى means 'to intend'; مَشْرُوع is 'project'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'I'll try to enter a PhD program'?
options: الْأَهَمُّ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُرْتَاحًا فِي عَمَلِي
exercises.tip: حَاوَلَ means 'to try'; الِالْتِحَاق is 'joining'.

exercises.prompt: Put these words in order: 'كَبِيرَة / سَأَتَقَدَّمُ / شَرِكَةٍ / لِوَظِيفَةٍ / فِي'.

too_formal.item: رَحْ قَدِّم عَ وَظِيفَة بِشَرِكَة كْبِيرَة

exercises.tip: The describing word كَبِيرَة comes after the noun it describes.

phrases.arabic: هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي الذَّهَابُ إِلَى دَوْرَةِ الْمِيَاه؟
phrases.transliteration: hal yumkinunee adh-dhahaabu ilaa dawrati al-miyaah?

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أُسْتَاذ سَالِم. كَيْفَ حَالُ ابْنِي فِي الْمَدْرَسَة؟
dialogue.transliteration: as-salaamu 3alaykum yaa ustaadh Saalim. kayfa 7aalu ibnee fee al-madrasa?
dialogue.english: Peace be upon you, Mr. Salim. How is my son doing at school?

dialogue.speaker: Salim
dialogue.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّه. ابْنُكِ طَالِبٌ مُجْتَهِد.
dialogue.transliteration: wa 3alaykumu as-salaamu wa ra7matu allaah. ibnuki taalibun mujtahid.
dialogue.english: And peace and Allah's mercy be upon you. Your son is a diligent student.

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: هَلْ يُنْجِزُ وَاجِبَهُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ؟
dialogue.transliteration: hal yunjizu waajibahu kulla yawmin?
dialogue.english: Does he do his homework every day?

dialogue.speaker: Salim
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، وَلَكِنَّهُ يَنْسَى قَلَمَهُ أَحْيَانًا.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, wa lakinnahu yansaa qalamahu a7yaanan.
dialogue.english: Yes, but he sometimes forgets his pen.

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: سَأُذَكِّرُهُ كُلَّ صَبَاح. وَمَتَى يَنْتَهِي الْيَوْمُ الدِّرَاسِيّ؟
dialogue.transliteration: sa-udhakkiruhu kulla sabaa7. wa mataa yantahee al-yawmu ad-diraasiyy?
dialogue.english: I'll remind him every morning. And when does the school day end?

dialogue.speaker: Salim
dialogue.arabic: الِاسْتِرَاحَةُ عِنْدَ السَّاعَةِ الْعَاشِرَة، وَيَنْتَهِي الْيَوْمُ عِنْدَ الثَّانِيَة.
dialogue.transliteration: al-istiraa7atu 3inda as-saa3ati al-3aashira, wa yantahee al-yawmu 3inda ath-thaaniya.
dialogue.english: The break is at ten o'clock, and the day ends at two.

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: وَهَلْ يَلْبَسُ الزِّيَّ الْمَدْرَسِيَّ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ؟
dialogue.transliteration: wa hal yalbasu az-ziyya al-madrasiyya kulla yawmin?
dialogue.english: And does he wear the school uniform every day?

dialogue.speaker: Salim
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، الزِّيُّ الْمَدْرَسِيُّ مَطْلُوبٌ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الطُّلَّاب.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, az-ziyyu al-madrasiyyu matloobun min jamee3i at-tullaab.
dialogue.english: Yes, the school uniform is required of all students.

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي أَنْ أَرَى الْفَصْل؟
dialogue.transliteration: hal yumkinunee an araa al-fasl?
dialogue.english: May I see the classroom?

dialogue.speaker: Salim
dialogue.arabic: تَفَضَّلِي، الْفَصْلُ فِي آخِرِ الْمَمَرّ.
dialogue.transliteration: tafaddalee, al-faslu fee aakhiri al-mamarr.
dialogue.english: Go ahead, the classroom is at the end of the hallway.

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.arabic: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا يَا أُسْتَاذ.
dialogue.transliteration: shukran jazeelan yaa ustaadh.
dialogue.english: Thank you very much, sir.

dialogue.speaker: Salim
dialogue.arabic: أَهْلًا بِكِ فِي أَيِّ وَقْت.
dialogue.transliteration: ahlan biki fee ayyi waqt.
dialogue.english: You're welcome any time.

pair.arabic: هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي الذَّهَابُ إِلَى دَوْرَةِ الْمِيَاه؟
pair.transliteration: hal yumkinunee adh-dhahaabu ilaa dawrati al-miyaah?
pair.english: May I go to the bathroom?
When does the school day end?

lessons.culture: In many Arab countries students wear a school uniform, and the school week often runs from Sunday to Thursday. Students call a male teacher يَا أُسْتَاذ and a female teacher يَا أُسْتَاذَة, a sign of the respect teachers receive. Parents are welcome to meet the teacher and hear how their child is doing.

exercises.prompt: A teacher asks: 'فِي أَيِّ صَفٍّ أَنْتَ؟'. Say you are in the fifth grade.
exercises.tip: The number follows the noun and matches it: الصَّفّ is masculine, so الْخَامِس.

exercises.prompt: Your teacher asks: 'هَلْ أَنْجَزْتَ وَاجِبَكَ؟'. Say yes, you did it yesterday.
exercises.tip: The ending ـتُ means 'I' and ـهُ means 'it'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'اُكْتُبِ الدَّرْسَ عَلَى _____.' (Write the lesson on the board.)
exercises.tip: السَّبُّورَة is the classroom board; after عَلَى it ends with the vowel i.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'الِاسْتِرَاحَةُ عِنْدَ السَّاعَةِ _____.' (The break is at ten o'clock.)
exercises.tip: The hour is feminine, so the number is feminine too: الْعَاشِرَة.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'Where is my school bag?'
exercises.tip: The describing word الْمَدْرَسِيَّة comes after the noun it describes.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'I forgot my pen.'
exercises.tip: نَسِيَ means 'to forget'; ـتُ after it means 'I'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'Open your book to page ten'?
exercises.tip: اِفْتَحْ is the order 'open' to one man; ـكَ means 'your' for a man.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'My son is a diligent student'?
exercises.tip: مُجْتَهِد means 'hard-working' and follows the word it describes.

exercises.prompt: Put these words in order: 'الْمَدْرَسِيّ / لَا / الزِّيَّ / تَنْسَ'.
exercises.tip: لَا before a verb means 'don't', and the verb is shortened: تَنْسَ.

exercises.prompt: Put these words in order: 'الْمِيَاه / هَلْ / دَوْرَةِ / الذَّهَابُ / يُمْكِنُنِي / إِلَى'.
exercises.answer: هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي الذَّهَابُ إِلَى دَوْرَةِ الْمِيَاه
accepted: هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي الذَّهَابُ إِلَى دَوْرَةِ الْمِيَاه
هل يمكنني الذهاب الى دورة المياه
هَلْ أَسْتَطِيعُ الذَّهَابَ إِلَى دَوْرَةِ الْمِيَاه
hal yumkinunee adh-dhahaabu ilaa dawrati al-miyaah?
exercises.tip: هَلْ opens a yes-or-no question and comes first.

reply.english: My name is Karim, and I'm an engineer.
I have five years of experience.
I'm organized and I learn quickly.

dialogue.speaker: Faisal
dialogue.arabic: تَفَضَّلْ بِالْجُلُوسِ يَا كَرِيم. عَرِّفْ بِنَفْسِكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
dialogue.transliteration: tafaddal bil-juloosi yaa kareem. 3arrif bi-nafsika min fadlika.
dialogue.english: Please sit, Karim. Introduce yourself please.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.arabic: اِسْمِي كَرِيم، وَأَنَا مُهَنْدِس. تَخَرَّجْتُ مِنْ كُلِّيَّةِ الْهَنْدَسَة.
dialogue.transliteration: ismee kareem, wa anaa muhandis. takharrajtu min kulliyyati al-handasa.
dialogue.english: My name is Karim, and I'm an engineer. I graduated from the faculty of engineering.

dialogue.speaker: Faisal
dialogue.arabic: هَلْ هَذِهِ سِيرَتُكَ الذَّاتِيَّة؟
dialogue.transliteration: hal hadhihi seeratuka adh-dhaatiyya?
dialogue.english: Is this your CV?

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، هَذِهِ سِيرَتِي الذَّاتِيَّة.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, hadhihi seeratee adh-dhaatiyya.
dialogue.english: Yes, this is my CV.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.arabic: أَعْمَلُ جَيِّدًا مَعَ الْفَرِيق، وَأَتَحَدَّثُ الْعَرَبِيَّةَ وَالْإِنْجِلِيزِيَّة.
dialogue.transliteration: a3malu jayyidan ma3a al-fareeq, wa ata7addathu al-3arabiyya wa al-injileeziyya.
dialogue.english: I work well with the team, and I speak Arabic and English.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.arabic: أَتَوَقَّعُ رَاتِبًا مُنَاسِبًا لِخِبْرَتِي.
dialogue.transliteration: atawaqqa3u raatiban munaasiban likhibratee.
dialogue.english: I expect a salary that suits my experience.

dialogue.speaker: Faisal
dialogue.arabic: مَتَى يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تَبْدَأَ؟ سَنَتَّصِلُ بِكَ الْأُسْبُوعَ الْقَادِم.
dialogue.transliteration: mataa yumkinuka an tabda2a? sa-nattasilu bika al-usboo3a al-qaadim.
dialogue.english: When can you start? We will call you next week.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.arabic: أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَبْدَأَ غَدًا. شُكْرًا لَكَ عَلَى وَقْتِكَ.
dialogue.transliteration: astatee3u an abda2a ghadan. shukran laka 3alaa waqtika.
dialogue.english: I can start tomorrow. Thank you for your time.

response.english: My name is Karim, and I'm an engineer.

pair.english: How many years of experience do you have?

response.english: I have five years of experience.
I'm organized and I learn quickly.

lessons.culture: An interview in Arabic usually starts with a polite greeting and a little small talk before the questions begin. People bring a printed CV and copies of their certificates. When a start date is discussed, it is common to add إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّه, since the future is in Allah's hands.

exercises.prompt: An interviewer says: 'عَرِّفْ بِنَفْسِكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ'. Say your name is Karim and you are an engineer.
exercises.tip: مُهَنْدِس is 'engineer'; after أَنَا no word for 'am' is needed.

exercises.prompt: He asks: 'كَمْ سَنَةً مِنَ الْخِبْرَةِ لَدَيْكَ؟'. Say you have five years of experience.
exercises.tip: لَدَيَّ means 'I have'; خَمْس takes the plural: سَنَوَات.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'تَخَرَّجْتُ مِنْ _____ الْهَنْدَسَة.' (I graduated from the faculty of engineering.)
exercises.tip: After مِنْ the noun ends with the vowel i: كُلِّيَّةِ.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'سَنَتَّصِلُ بِكَ _____ الْقَادِم.' (We will call you next week.)
exercises.tip: A word that says 'when' ends with the vowel a: الْأُسْبُوعَ.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'This is my CV.'
exercises.tip: هَذِهِ is 'this' for a feminine word like سِيرَة.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'Why do you want to work with us?'
exercises.tip: After أَنْ the verb ends with the vowel a: تَعْمَلَ.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'What salary do you expect?'
exercises.tip: الرَّاتِب is 'salary'; تَتَوَقَّعُ means 'you expect'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'I speak Arabic and English'?
exercises.tip: تَحَدَّثَ means 'to speak' and takes the language directly.

exercises.prompt: Put these words in order: 'مِنَ / سَنَوَاتٍ / خَمْسُ / لَدَيَّ / الْخِبْرَة'.
exercises.tip: The thing you have comes after لَدَيَّ.

exercises.prompt: Put these words in order: 'أَسْتَطِيعُ / أَنْ / غَدًا / أَبْدَأَ'.
exercises.tip: The time word غَدًا usually comes last.

challenge.title: Talk about work, study and plans
challenge.instructions: Write a short conversation in Fusha between two people who meet at a university. One asks what the other does, they talk about their major and an exam or a meeting, then they share plans for the future.
required_elements: what each person does (work or study)
an exam, lecture or meeting with a time
a plan or dream for the future

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.arabic: مَرْحَبًا يَا مَرْيَم. مَا عَمَلُكِ؟
dialogue.transliteration: marhaban yaa Maryam. maa 3amaluki?
dialogue.english: Hello, Maryam. What do you do?

dialogue.speaker: Maryam
dialogue.arabic: أَعْمَلُ مُعَلِّمَةً، وَمَا زِلْتُ أَدْرُسُ فِي الْجَامِعَة.
dialogue.transliteration: a3malu mu3allima, wa maa zultu adrusu fee al-jaami3a.
dialogue.english: I work as a teacher, and I'm still studying at university.

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.arabic: مَا تَخَصُّصُكِ؟
dialogue.transliteration: maa takhassusuki?
dialogue.english: What's your major?

dialogue.speaker: Maryam
dialogue.arabic: تَخَصُّصِي اللُّغَةُ الْعَرَبِيَّة. عِنْدِي اِمْتِحَانٌ غَدًا.
dialogue.transliteration: takhassusee al-lughatu al-3arabiyya. 3indee imti7aanun ghadan.
dialogue.english: My major is Arabic. I have an exam tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.arabic: بِالتَّوْفِيق! أَنَا عِنْدِي اجْتِمَاعٌ فِي السَّاعَةِ الْعَاشِرَة.
dialogue.transliteration: bit-tawfeeq! anaa 3indee ijtimaa3un fee as-saa3ati al-3aashira.
dialogue.english: Good luck! I have a meeting at ten o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: Maryam
dialogue.arabic: هَلْ يُرِيدُ الْمُدِيرُ أَنْ يَتَحَدَّثَ مَعَكَ؟
dialogue.transliteration: hal yureedu al-mudeeru an yata7addatha ma3aka?
dialogue.english: Does the manager want to talk to you?

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، وَلَمْ أُنْهِ التَّقْرِيرَ بَعْد.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, wa lam unhi at-taqreera ba3d.
dialogue.english: Yes, and I haven't finished the report yet.

dialogue.speaker: Maryam
dialogue.arabic: مَاذَا تَنْوِي أَنْ تَفْعَلَ فِي الْمُسْتَقْبَل؟
dialogue.transliteration: maadhaa tanwee an taf3ala fee al-mustaqbal?
dialogue.english: What do you plan to do in the future?

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.arabic: طُمُوحِي أَنْ أُصْبِحَ مُدِيرًا يَوْمًا مَا. وَأَنْتِ؟
dialogue.transliteration: tumoo7ee an usbi7a mudeeran yawman maa. wa anti?
dialogue.english: My ambition is to become a manager one day. And you?

dialogue.speaker: Maryam
dialogue.arabic: حُلْمِي أَنْ أُكْمِلَ دِرَاسَتِي لِلدُّكْتُورَاه.
dialogue.transliteration: 7ulmee an ukmila diraasatee lid-duktooraah.
dialogue.english: My dream is to continue my studies for a doctorate.
